Anaemia prevention in India: pivoting towards better multidimensional strategies
results.content: If anaemia reduction should align with India’s goals for NCD reduction, then the focus must be on better diets through diversification. That should be non-negotiable for public health policy: no amount of papering over cracks with pills and potions will work in the long term
